description: This file implements a React-based dialog management system, including a DialogManager class that handles opening, closing, and registering dialogs, with support for asynchronous operations and cleanup.

classes.name: _DialogManager
classes.description: A class managing dialog instances, including opening, closing, and registration of dialogs with support for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a dialog component with specified props, returns a promise resolving to the result or false if already open.

methods.name: closeAll
methods.description: Closes all open dialogs and removes modal elements from the DOM.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a dialog component with optional pre-open hook, providing show and close methods.
